note: Lawful clauses on the same topics the rules watch — nothing void should fire.
text:
The tenant shall pay rent of $1,000 on the first day of each month.
The landlord shall maintain the rental unit in a good state of repair.
The landlord may enter the unit with 24 hours' written notice between 8 a.m. and 8 p.m.
The tenant must pay for any damage caused by the tenant or their guests.
A refundable key deposit of $50 is required.
Animals of any kind are not permitted in the rental unit.
Tenants may not have overnight visitors more than twice a week.
A non-refundable cleaning charge of $200 will be deducted when the tenant moves out.
Rent paid after the 5th of the month incurs a penalty of $25 per day.
The tenant is responsible for all plumbing and appliance repairs regardless of cause.
The landlord or their agent may show the unit to prospective tenants without prior notice.
The tenant agrees not to sublet or assign this lease under any circumstances.
The tenant will share the kitchen and washroom with the landlord's family, who live upstairs.
This unit is exempt from rent control because it was first occupied in 2021.

note: Smoking rules and tenant insurance are allowed additional terms; snow removal isn't a landlord repair.
text:
No smoking is permitted inside the unit.
The tenant is responsible for snow removal on the front walkway.
The tenant must obtain tenant insurance before move-in.
Guests are welcome; the tenant is responsible for the behaviour of their guests.

note: A realistic bad lease with several void clauses mixed in with lawful ones.
text:
1. Rent is $875 per month for a room in a shared house.
2. A damage deposit of $400 is due at signing.
3. No pets.
4. The tenant pays a $40 late fee for rent received after the 1st.
5. The landlord may access the room at any time to check cleanliness.
6. The tenant must keep common areas clean.
